sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the non-hemispherical contact-geometry alternative without changing the retained ship-level case minCount, capacity >= demand DIRECT_CHECK, or complete classification branches. The current non-hemispherical sh:or member is a property shape whose nested sh:property for nltl:contactGeometryCorrespondenceEvidence is evaluated on the contact-geometry value node, but that property’s authoritative owner is the thrusterIceImpactLoadCase. Make the alternative a case-level node shape (or otherwise apply the evidence constraint to the case node) while retaining sh:path nltl:contactGeometryClassification and sh:hasValue nltl:nonHemisphericalContactGeometry.
